Tests stake history bincode bounds and sysvar cache update behavior.

# Purpose
This file is a unit test for the `stake_history` sysvar. It checks the binary decode footprint, alignment, and encoded size of `example_stake_history` against the `fd_stake_history` type, then verifies that `fd_sysvar_stake_history_update` behaves correctly in the sysvar cache. The test sets the required rent and epoch schedule values in the bank, confirms that an update does not change the cache when the slot is not at an epoch boundary, and confirms that the cache contains valid stake history data after the update path runs.
